# Hugh Carrow

## Overview

- **Age:** 14 to 17 years old  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c19 P44](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0044), [v1 c25 P61](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0061)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P32](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0032), [v1 c21 P24](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0024)</sub>
- **Role:** Student and schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038)</sub>
- **Titles:** Medalist  <sub>[v1 c36 P3](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0003)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Hughie  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c17 P38](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0038)</sub>

## Appearance

Hugh is a tall youth with wavy chestnut hair, mischievous light-brown or hazel eyes, a distinctive chin, and a mocking grin. As he matures, he becomes a handsome, manly young man with strong resemblance to his father.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c28 P32](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0032), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c37 P37](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0037)_

## Personality

Hugh is a mischievous and playful boy who enjoys teasing his female classmates, though he possesses a friendly, generous, and self-denying nature. He is highly intelligent, ambitious, and competitive, working hard to achieve academic success. When he realizes he has caused offense, he is willing to offer genuine apologies.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P42](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0042), [v1 c15 P49](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0049), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c30 P24](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0024), [v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038)_

- Mischievous and teasing  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028)</sub>

- To earn money through teaching to fund his own college education  <sub>[v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038)</sub>

## History

Hugh spent three years in Alberta with his father before returning to Brierley and re-entering the fourth class at school. During his first day back, he teased Nell Harcourt by calling her 'Carrots', prompting her to smash her slate over his head, though he took the blame for the incident. When Nell refused to attend school after being made to sit beside him, Hugh tried to apologize, but she rejected him and vowed never to speak to him again. Despite her hostility, he competed closely with her for academic honors at Brierley school and joined her in Miss Thorne's advanced Regent's class. Later, Hugh saved Nell from a sinking flat near the bridge at Pembroke's pond, but when he asked for her friendship again, she coldly refused. Both attended Regent's Academy in town, where Hugh tied for top marks with Nell on the Entrance exams and won the Medalist title. To help pay his way through college, he accepted a teaching post in Pale Sands and voluntarily withdrew his application for the Brierley school so Nell could teach close to home. Upon learning of his sacrifice, Nell finally forgave him, and the two agreed to become close friends.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c15 P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 c15 P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 c15 P42](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0042), [v1 c15 P49](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0049), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c28 P23](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0023), [v1 c28 P26](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0026), [v1 c28 P31](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0031), [v1 c28 P33](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0033), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c30 P24](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0024), [v1 c32 P40](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0040), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c36 P3](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0003), [v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038), [v1 c38 P50](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0050), [v1 c38 P54](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0054), [v1 c38 P55](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0055)_

## Background by volume

- Lived in Alberta for three years due to his father's health, missing much schooling  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>
- Visited cousins in New Brunswick during a summer break  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016)</sub>

> Mr. Pidgeon, the blame belongs to me because I provoked her.  <sub>[v1 c15 P42](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0042)</sub>
